title: I10: Quality records: what to show or export for an auditor
public_pr_body:
Short clause-by-clause checklist of actual screens, list exports, prints and the optional year-end pack. Distinguishes screen viewing from exports, identifies external JNR records, and warns about filters, the 25-entry audit view and unresolved ZIP records.

Tolra supports JNR’s quality work; software/documents cannot certify JNR. JNR is audited.

- [x] Source and whitespace checks; published tree matches local commit.
- [ ] John/Rhys reviews actual installed system, company decisions and evidence.

Builder 5 / I10, explicit Rhys assignment; atomic claim claims/I10. One document under docs/iso9001/, independent of other drafts. No runtime tests or live exports run. No feature build, Ready label, main merge or production SQL. Builders 3/4 unchanged. Handover and remaining decisions are recorded in the document; existing I1–I7 drafts remain unchanged.
